title: Q-AUDIT-seed-live: fm-seed-undeployed failing (fail): Dispatch .github/workflows/deploy-workers.yml (it runs deploy/deploy-seed.mjs); read the failing row in ops/deploys.jsonl; fix the seed, never the probe (SEED-DEPLOY-1).
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe seed-live
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-seed-undeployed` detected by `seed-live`, failing since 2026-11-26T15:57:39Z.
Evidence: second-tenant: no live-verified seed deploy recorded in ops/deploys.jsonl

Signature: a9eb50934315 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: an admitted seed was never deployed, or its Worker stopped answering /health
Changed since the last passing commit 559cdb560d: `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`, `.editorconfig`, `.github/workflows/checks.yml`, `.github/workflows/cleanroom.yml`, `.github/workflows/cost-guard.yml`, `.github/workflows/deploy-ultrastable.yml`, `.github/workflows/failure-audit.yml`, `.github/workflows/findable.yml`, `.github/workflows/lane.yml`, `.github/workflows/openstd.yml`, `.github/workflows/org-settings.yml`, `.github/workflows/pages-enable.yml` (and 933 more)
Remedy: Dispatch .github/workflows/deploy-workers.yml (it runs deploy/deploy-seed.mjs); read the failing row in ops/deploys.jsonl; fix the seed, never the probe (SEED-DEPLOY-1).
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe seed-live

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T16:04:25Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 98.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
